beats.speaker: narration
beats.text: Riley's back a few days later, tour offer still sitting unanswered.

beats.speaker: reader
beats.text: You set the Fool back down between you.

beats.speaker: client
beats.text: "So does this card mean the tour's definitely going to work out for me?"

options.text: No — it's not a prediction, it's about the leap itself.
It has nothing to do with the tour at all.

elaboration: The Fool never promises a landing. It's a card about the jump, not the outcome — how the tour actually goes is still yours to find out.

beats.speaker: client
beats.text: "What if the tour falls apart and I've got nothing to go back to?"

options.text: That's the risk — saying yes to the unknown, not playing safe.
Then you'll have wasted your shot.
It won't fall apart if you don't think about it.

elaboration: The card doesn't pretend there's no risk — it just says the unknown is worth saying yes to anyway, instead of staying somewhere merely safe.

beats.speaker: client
beats.text: "I don't even know what happens after the tour ends."

options.text: You don't need that yet — the path shows up once you step.
Then you're not ready to go at all.

elaboration: The Fool trusts that the ground appears once you're already moving. Not knowing the ending isn't a hole in the plan — it's the plan.

beats.speaker: client
beats.text: "My parents think I'm ruining my life over this."

options.text: That reaction proves the point — it's against-convention energy.
They're right, you should listen to them.
What your parents think isn't relevant.

elaboration: The Fool was never going to look sensible to the people expecting you to stay on the program's path. That's not a flaw in the reading.

beats.speaker: client
beats.text: "Everyone in my program's been doing this way longer than me. I'd be starting over from nothing."

options.text: Starting over isn't weakness — it's a beginner's mind.
You should feel behind, because you are.
Experience doesn't come into this at all.

elaboration: A beginner's mind is curious and unjaded, not behind — that's an asset on a tour, not a deficit next to everyone else's years.

beats.speaker: reader
beats.text: One more thing — the Fool travels light. Whatever you decide, taking it with a little levity beats carrying every worst case with you.

beats.speaker: client
beats.text: "Thanks. I think I get it now — this isn't reckless, it's just a leap I'm allowed to take without already knowing where I land. I needed to hear that."
